title: RenderThread, Display Lists, and Hardware Acceleration Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies renderthread, display lists, and hardware acceleration?
options: Treat hardware rendering as recorded scene plus asynchronous execution, and use layers or drawing changes only when traces show the responsible cost.
questions.answer: Treat hardware rendering as recorded scene plus asynchronous execution, and use layers or drawing changes only when traces show the responsible cost.
questions.explanation: This answer keeps the ownership boundaries distinct and requires version-matched evidence, failure testing, compatibility, and operational follow-through.

questions.prompt: Hardware acceleration moves all View measurement, layout, and drawing work off the main thread.
questions.explanation: Leaving hardware layers enabled permanently can retain large textures and increase memory or update cost after the animation benefit ends.

questions.prompt: What work does the UI thread commonly contribute in hardware-accelerated View rendering?
questions.answer: It handles state, measurement, layout, traversal, and records drawing operations for the rendering pipeline.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the mechanism and owner that make the explanation causal rather than a memorised sequence.
